title: Asymptotic Rigidity and Boundary Structure of Yang's Numerical Invariants for the Bidisk Submodules $[z^k-w^\ell]$
summary: Let \[ M_{k,\ell}=[z^k-w^\ell]\subset H^2(\mathbb D^2), \qquad k,\ell\in\mathbb N,\quad k\ne\ell . \] We study the large-index asymptotics of Yang's numerical invariants and the boundary structure of their generating function. Starting from the exact staircase formula obtained in our preceding work, we prove that \[ Σ_j(M_{k,\ell}) = \frac{C_{k,\ell}}{j} + O(j^{-2}), \] where \[ C_{k,\ell} = \int_0^\infty \frac{x^2} {(x+1/k)^2(x+1/\ell)^2}\,dx . \] The first strict descent together with $C_{k,\ell}$ recovers the unordered pair $\{k,\ell\}$, yielding an asymptotic rigidity principle.
